description: This is a bar chart titled "Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst." The chart is divided into two sections, each representing a different set of data. The first section is labeled "Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" and the second section is labeled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." Both sections have a horizontal axis labeled "Dataset and Metrics" and a vertical axis labeled "Score (%)". The first section has four sets of bars, each representing a different model: LLaMA-3-8B-inst, Ours (SFT baseline), Ours (DPO baseline), and Ours (Iterative RLHF). The second section has two sets of bars, each representing a different model: LLaMA-3-8B-inst and Ours (Iterative RLHF). The bars in both sections are color-coded to represent the different models. The chart is used to compare the performance of the different models on various datasets and metrics.
